prompts.tonyMotionPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation source sheet for Tony, reference image identity/style. Transparent background. Exactly 12 equally spaced cells in a 4 column x 3 row grid, 1536x1024 canvas. No text, borders or labels. Each cell 384x341. All figures face right, identical scale, same head size, navy work shirt WITHOUT overalls, teal work trousers, brown boots/tool belt, dark spiky hair. WEAPON-FREE and ARM-FREE modular bodies: head torso hips legs only, shoulder sockets as reference. Row1 cells1-4: actual running sequence contact right foot forward, compression, passing, flight. Row2 cells1-2: opposite contact left foot forward, opposite passing. Row2 cells3-4: jump takeoff crouch and rising knees bent behind torso. Row3 cells1-4: apex tucked knees, falling feet reaching down, landing compression, hurt torso flinch. Real different articulated leg positions, alternating stride, not duplicated standing poses. Keep torso upright and shoulders near same position in every cell for separate aim arms. Full body contained each cell, wide transparent gutters. Detailed clean pixel-art matching reference, not photoreal, no shadows/background, no weapons, no arms. Standing reference body height around250px per cell, consistent scale through crouches; baseline at cell y300. Maintain modest Tony build and clothing. Output true alpha transparency.

prompts.deathPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Two hero death animation sprite sequences on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no glow, no shadow, alpha zero everywhere outside figures.
